prompt:
You are renaming a screenshot file so its owner can find it later by searching.

Look at the screenshot and answer in exactly three lines, nothing else:
TITLE: 3 to 8 words that say what this screenshot is about. Name the specific thing: the error, the item bought, the place, the people's plan, the topic, the app or project. Use words that appear on screen when they are the best name for it. No dates, no "screenshot of".
TYPE: one word from this list:
  code = source code, a code editor, a diff or pull request, a config file
  error = an error message, stack trace, failed build or warning dialog
  chat = a text, DM or group chat conversation
  receipt = a receipt, order confirmation, invoice or bill
  travel = a boarding pass, hotel or trip booking, map or directions
  schedule = a calendar, timetable, event flyer or invitation
  article = an article, documentation page, wiki or blog post
  social = a social media post or profile
  account = a bank or payment app, sign-in, security or settings screen
  document = a form, ID, syllabus, spreadsheet, slide or PDF page
  chart = a chart, graph or dashboard
  other = anything else: a photo, meme or drawing
PRIVATE: yes or no. Say yes only if the image itself shows a secret or an identity document: a password, a one-time or verification code, recovery codes, an API key or token, a full card number with expiry, an account balance, or a driver license or ID. A page that only talks about passwords, or a list of Wi-Fi network names, is no.
